headline: R2-RE's row stays the headline; this block attaches labels
null: y_s = L q_hat + K eps_s on the NGC 4258-only rows (37 hosts), under C; the most extreme host by criterion X or S is dropped before tau_hat and the spread are computed

settings.subsets_x_s_spread: first sel_n_subsets index draws rng.choice(36, 10) of default_rng(r4_seed), mapped onto the 36 columns other than d
settings.subsets_criterion_s: the first sel_n_subsets R4 draws on 37 hosts (ROB part B's)

spread.label: the R4 spread is consistent with C

tau.label: τ̂_N not unusual under the selected null

spread_X.label: the 36-host spread is consistent with the selected null (X)

spread_S.label: the 36-host spread is consistent with the selected null (S)

extremeness.note: descriptive: how extreme the host is as the most extreme of 37 under C; no label

reading: the excess calibrator scatter of R2-RE-ROB is consistent with one outlying host, selection included
section5: the post-hoc gloss 'consistent with one outlying host' becomes the pre-registered reading of this test, quoted with the caveat that the tau part uses criterion X only (its p expected to be higher than under an aligned criterion)

not_lowered_vs_bn.note: descriptive: True means the selection did not lower that p value in this setup (B-N's p from the same run); it does not override rules (3) and (4)
